svg.title: Time of one call with the same integrity check
svg.desc: Small multiples: rows for Rust and Python, columns for N of 0, 127, 1788, and 87381 spikes. NCP 2 over a pipe, a Unix socket, and TCP in blue; gRPC, ZeroMQ, HTTP/1.1, Zenoh, and the raw pipe, each with a SHA-256 digest of every message checked by the receiver, in gray. Values are in summary.md.
